column1: # THE BAR-LENGTH SYSTEMATIC ON R, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED.
# Cuomo, Lee, Buttitta, Aguerri, Corsini & Morelli 2021, A&A 649, A30 (arXiv:2103.00343),
# "Bar pattern speeds in CALIFA galaxies III. Solving the puzzle of ultrafast bars".
# Transcribed (2026-09-03) from the arXiv LaTeX source, Table A.1 (R_1..R_6) and Table 2 (R_Qb).
# ONE corotation radius per galaxy (from TW), divided by SEVEN different published bar-radius estimates:
#   R1 = R_eps,peak (ellipticity peak)     R2 = R_PA (position-angle profile)
#   R5 = R_trann (transition)               R6 = R_A2 (m=2 Fourier amplitude)
#   R7 = R_Qb (transverse-to-radial force ratio map, this paper's own new measurement; Table 2 col 5)
# Every row is the SAME galaxy and the SAME pattern speed, so the spread across columns is PURELY the
# bar-length definition.  "nan" where the paper prints a dash.
